text: One for the tracker: What is the site for the store whose appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift at Marrow Agrisupply? I need it for the QBR deck.
reply_text:
The Marrow Agrisupply store is Pine Crossing. I've replied to Hollis in the thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api.

The answer comes from #central-team, where Hollis is a member. On 9 June 2026, Priyanka said Pine Crossing's morning receiver could only see the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver had turned up at 7:10 and they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. I didn't find a later message in that channel saying the shift was fixed, and I told Hollis that.

text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging? Need it before the customer call.
reply_text:
The ticket is #88412. I've replied to Tobias in the thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api.
